pr_body:
* Throw an error if a record type property has validation metadata
* Disallow TryUpdateModel on a top-level record type
* Ignore previously specified model value when binding a record type
* Unskip record type tests
* Clean up record type detection

Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/24265

issue_context.title: Model binding record type follow ups

review_comments: Don't believe this attribute is correct. It implies `_parameterMapping` is `null` _before_ the method runs.
No, it instructs the compiler that _parameterMapping will always have a value after this method has been called.
Nice to have doc comments for `internal` API given the complexities in this area❕
Do we already have tests covering mix of constructor parameter metadata and validation metadata on properties not mentioned in the primary constructor❔ Those should succeed.
I don't think there was one before, I've added one now.
nit: Suggest mentioning records in this comment. That saves looking at the `BoundConstructor` doc comments.
